MIRAMAR BEACH (APPROX. 14 KM) A serene and quiet beach located near Panaji, perfect for evening walks or relaxing by the sea. VAGATOR BEACH (APPROX. 15 KM) A tranquil beach surrounded by cliffs and green hills, Vagator is known for its scenic beauty, relaxed vibe, and popular sunset views.

accordion_sections.title: What is Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: Casino Palms Goa is a popular casino located in Candolim, North Goa. It offers a wide variety of table games, slot machines, and live entertainment. The casino is part of the Casino Group in Goa and is known for its vibrant atmosphere and high-quality service.

accordion_sections.title: What games are available at Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: At Casino Palms Goa, guests can enjoy a variety of games, including Blackjack, Roulette, Poker (including Texas Hold’em), Baccarat, and numerous slot machines. The casino offers both traditional table games and modern electronic gaming options.

accordion_sections.title: What is the dress code for Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: The dress code at Casino Palms Goa is smart-casual. Men are advised to wear collared shirts and closed-toe shoes, while women can wear smart casual dresses or tops and pants. Beachwear or overly casual attire like flip-flops and shorts are not allowed.

accordion_sections.title: How can I book a visit to Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: You can book a visit to Casino Palms Goa either by visiting their official website, where they may offer online booking for gaming packages or by calling the casino directly. Additionally, if you are staying at the Casino Palms Resort, your booking will likely include casino access.

accordion_sections.title: What are the best times to visit Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: The best time to visit Casino Palms Goa is during the winter season from November to February. The weather is cooler and more comfortable, and it coincides with the peak tourist season in Goa. The festive period around Christmas and New Year brings special events and activities.

accordion_sections.title: Is Casino Palms Goa open to all visitors?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Casino Palms Goa is open to both tourists and locals. However, visitors must be at least 21 years of age to enter the casino floor and play games. An ID proof is required for entry.

accordion_sections.title: Are there any special packages available at Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: Casino Palms Goa offers a variety of gaming packages, including stay-and-play packages, VIP packages, and day packages. These packages often include casino credits, accommodation, dining, and entertainment options. You can check the official website or contact the casino for specific deals and availability.

accordion_sections.title: How do I reach Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: Casino Palms Goa is located in Candolim, about 35 km from Dabolim Airport and around 20 km from Thivim Railway Station. You can reach the casino by taxi, private car, or local buses from nearby towns like Panaji and Calangute.

accordion_sections.title: What amenities are available at Casino Palms Goa?
accordion_sections.content: Casino Palms Goa offers a range of amenities, including luxurious accommodations at the Casino Palms Resort, restaurants, bar services, live entertainment, and swimming pools. The casino provides a comfortable and lively environment for guests to enjoy gaming, dining, and relaxation.

Casino Palms, located in the bustling Candolim area of North Goa, is a premier gaming destination offering an exciting and immersive casino experience. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, it is part of the "Casino Group" in Goa, which also includes other renowned properties. The casino is situated within a luxury resort, providing a combination of leisure and gaming to its guests. Guests can enjoy luxurious amenities, a multi-cuisine restaurant, and the proximity to the beautiful beaches of North Goa. It's a great destination for those looking to combine gaming with a beach vacation.

Casino Palms provides a luxurious and comfortable setting with elegant interiors, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere. Guests can relax in the casino's lounge or enjoy drinks from the bar. The resort also offers a range of amenities such as a swimming pool, wellness facilities, and proximity to the beautiful beaches of Candolim and Calangute, making it a perfect blend of gaming and relaxation.

Inside, the casino offers a wide array of gaming options, including popular table games such as Blackjack, Roulette, and Poker. It also features a variety of slot machines for players who enjoy more casual gaming. Whether you're an experienced gambler or a first-timer, Casino Palms caters to all levels of players, ensuring a thrilling experience.

The casino is complemented by a restaurant that serves a variety of multi-cuisine dishes, ranging from local Goan fare to international delicacies. Guests can relax with a drink from the bar, enjoy live music, and unwind in the vibrant ambience. Located near Baga Beach, Casino Palms offers easy access to the beach, allowing visitors to enjoy the best of Goa's nightlife, gaming, and coastal charm. It is a great spot for those seeking a fun, exciting, and luxurious gaming experience with a touch of Goa’s relaxed beach atmosphere.
Casino Palms in Goa offers a wide variety of games to cater to both experienced gamblers and newcomers. Some of the popular games you can find at Casino Palms include:
Roulette – A classic casino game where players bet on where a ball will land on a spinning wheel. The game has different variations, including European and American Roulette.
Blackjack – A card game where the objective is to get as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it. Players compete against the dealer, not each other.
Poker – Casino Palms offers various forms of poker, including Texas Hold’em and other popular variants. Poker tables cater to players of different skill levels, from beginners to pros.
Slot Machines – The casino features a variety of slot machines with different themes, bonus features, and jackpots. These offer a more casual gaming experience with the possibility of large payouts.
Baccarat – A card game where players can bet on three possible outcomes: Player, Banker, or Tie. It is one of the most popular high-stakes games at the casino.
Dice Games – In addition to table games, Casino Palms often offers games that involve dice, adding variety to the gaming options.
Electronic Gaming – For those who prefer digital options, the casino features a range of electronic gaming machines, which include video slots and digital table games.
The dress code at Casino Palms Goa is formal or smart casual.
For men: Avoid shorts, sleeveless shirts, and flip-flops.
For women: Dress modestly and elegantly.
It's always a good idea to err on the side of caution and dress more formally to ensure entry.

The entry fee to Casino Palms in Goa generally starts at INR 1,000 on Fridays and weekends, and INR 700 from Monday to Thursday. This usually includes unlimited food and drinks while gaming. These prices are subject to change, so it's always best to check with the casino directly for the most up-to-date information. You can contact them through their official website or by phone.
To book a visit to Casino Palms in Goa, you have a few options:

Online Booking: You can check availability and book online through the official website of Casino Palms or through third-party booking platforms that feature casinos and resorts in Goa. Online booking may allow you to select packages or offers related to gaming, dining, or stay.

Call or Email: You can contact Casino Palms directly by phone or email to inquire about availability, game reservations, and any special promotions. The casino's staff can help you book tables for games, events, or special occasions.

Hotel or Resort Packages: If you are staying at the Casino Palms Resort, your booking may also include access to the casino. The resort may offer various packages that include gaming credits, spa services, and other amenities along with your accommodation.

Dabolim Airport (Goa International Airport) is the nearest airport, located about 35 kilometres (approximately 45 minutes by car) from Casino Palms. From the airport, you can hire a taxi or book a private transfer to the casino.

The closest major railway station is Thivim Railway Station, located around 20 kilometres (30-40 minutes by car) from Casino Palms. You can take a taxi or auto-rickshaw from the station to reach the casino.
Madgaon Railway Station (in South Goa) is another option but is farther away (about 90 minutes by car).
From Panaji (Capital City): Casino Palms is approximately 12 kilometres (20-25 minutes by car) from Panaji. You can hire a taxi, rent a car, or use local buses to reach Candolim.
From Calangute: The casino is around 5 kilometres (10-15 minutes by car) from Calangute Beach, a popular tourist spot.

By Bus: Local buses run from Panaji and other major towns to Candolim. However, taking a taxi or private vehicle might be more convenient, especially if you're carrying luggage or looking for direct access.

Taxis and auto-rickshaws are widely available in Goa, especially around tourist hubs like Candolim, Calangute, and Baga. You can book a taxi or auto-rickshaw directly to Casino Palms. It’s recommended to confirm the fare beforehand or ensure that the meter is running.

The best time to visit Casino Palms in Goa is during the winter season, from November to February. This period offers pleasant weather, with cooler temperatures and less humidity, making it ideal for enjoying both the casino and outdoor activities in Goa. The festive season, especially around Christmas and New Year's, also brings a lively atmosphere to the region, with vibrant nightlife, special events, and celebrations. However, if you prefer to avoid crowds, visiting in the off-season months like April to June can also provide a quieter experience, though the weather is hotter.
